description: This Java source file defines the MockLegacySirenRepeaterCluster class, which extends MockLegacySecurityCluster and implements Tamperable and BatteryBackedUp interfaces. It simulates a legacy siren repeater device with capabilities to handle manufacturing commands, get status, and manage tampering and power/battery states for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockLegacySirenRepeaterCluster
classes.description: A mock simulation of a legacy siren repeater security device, capable of handling commands and reporting status for testing integrations.

classes.name: SirenMode
classes.description: Enumeration representing different siren modes, including off, fire, and burglar alert sounds.

classes.name: ClientMfgCommand
classes.description: Container for command constants sent to the device, such as siren mode, status, and LED settings.

methods.name: handleMfgCommand
methods.description: Handles manufacturer commands, sets device states based on command ID and payload.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the device status bitmap indicating tamper, power loss, and battery status.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Checks if the device has been tampered with.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tampered state of the device and reports status if changed.

methods.name: isACPowerLost
methods.description: Checks if AC power is lost.

methods.name: setACPowerLost
methods.description: Updates AC power loss state and reports changes.

methods.name: isBatteryBad
methods.description: Checks if the battery is considered bad.

methods.name: setBatteryBad
methods.description: Updates battery health state and reports changes.

methods.name: isBatteryMissing
methods.description: Indicates that the device does not detect missing batteries.

methods.name: setBatteryMissing
methods.description: Logs a warning that missing batteries are not detected.
